summary: Robinhood Markets, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a private offering of $2.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2029. Proceeds will enhance strategic flexibility, with ~$300 million used to repurchase Class A common stock.
